title: MQTT internal subscriptions can bypass topic deny rules
summary:
### Background

NATS is an open source messaging system for cloud, on-premises and edge deployments.

NATS MQTT support uses internal subjects to store and deliver messages. User-facing subscribe permissions apply to the original topic namespace.

### Problem Description

MQTT clients could subscribe directly to internal message subjects that were not covered by the original topic deny rules. A client denied access to a topic could consequently receive message contents through an internal alias in the same account. The fix described here covers MQTT-protocol subscriptions; native NATS-client access is a separate related issue.

### Affected Versions

The issue is fixed in v2.12.14, v2.14.4 and v2.15.0. Earlier versions containing the affected functionality are vulnerable; the first affected version has not been established for this notice.

### Workarounds

Upgrade to a fixed release.

### References

 * GHSA advisory: <https://github.com/nats-io/nats-server/security/advisories/GHSA-m996-6cph-cjhc>
